payload.title: CK Tile MoE / Norm / Conv / Reduce Operations
payload.summary: In addition to GEMM and Attention, Composable Kernel (CK) Tile provides a rich set of commonly used operator implementations for LLM inference and training, including Fused MoE (sorting + GEMM + activation fusion), TopK Softmax, LayerNorm/RMSNorm (with quantization fusion), Grouped Convolution, im2col, Reduce, and Pooling. All operators follow the CK Tile three-layer architecture of kernel / pipeline / block.

sections.heading: Fused MoE GEMM
sections.gist: `include/ck_tile/ops/fused_moe/` implements the complete Mixture-of-Experts inference pipeline, including token sorting and back-to-back dual GEMM fusion.

sections.heading: LayerNorm2d
sections.gist: `include/ck_tile/ops/layernorm2d/` implements 2D LayerNorm (normalization along the last dimension).

sections.heading: Grouped Convolution
sections.gist: `include/ck_tile/ops/grouped_convolution/` implements forward/backward computation of grouped convolution.
